request.raw_text: Add cylindrical heads on the long pins to prevent link arms against slipping off.

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The exposed ends of the long pivot pins supporting the link arms at the upper and lower plates.
areas_to_change.location: At each exposed axial end of the long pins where the outer link arms could move off the pin.
areas_to_change.description: Extend or terminate the applicable long pins with cylindrical heads having a diameter larger than the link-arm pivot holes. The heads should sit outside the link arms and provide axial retention without clamping the joints.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Upper and lower red plates, including their elongated guide slots
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve all plate dimensions, spacing, slot geometry, and existing pin locations.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Blue crossed link arms and center pivots
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve link profiles, lengths, thicknesses, pivot-hole geometry, crossed arrangement, and rotational freedom.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Existing pin axes and linkage alignment
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Keep every pin coaxial with its current joint and do not alter the linkage kinematics or plate travel.
Maintain sufficient axial and radial clearance so the new heads retain the arms without interfering with rotation, sliding, or adjacent components.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The long pivot pins will have enlarged coaxial cylindrical heads at their exposed retaining ends, forming shoulders outside the link arms.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The added heads will act as axial stops that retain the link arms on the long pins.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The linkage will continue to rotate and slide through its existing range while the link arms remain captured and cannot slip off the pin ends.

ambiguities.description: The request does not explicitly identify which pins qualify as long pins or whether heads are required on one or both ends.
candidate_interpretations: Add heads to every exposed end of the four plate-to-link pivot pins.
Add heads only to currently unheaded ends of through-pins spanning both linkage sides.
Add heads to both ends of each long through-pin.

ambiguities.description: The cylindrical-head dimensions and retention construction are unspecified.
candidate_interpretations: Add separate cylindrical caps or retainers.
Match the diameter and thickness of existing visible pin heads.
